ex.s: As they grew more mobile, we let them move freely around the house during the day, but when we were asleep we had to contain them in a large room, otherwise they'd get up to mischief.
ex.t: 随着它们越来越能活动，白天我们让它们在屋里自由走动，但我们睡着时得把它们关在一个大房间里，否则它们会调皮捣蛋。

ex.s: Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.
ex.t: 去年，该基金会报告称，近60%的7至12岁儿童说他们白天感到疲倦，15%说他们在学校里睡着了。

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为激素的身体化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年身体发育出成人特征，还让他们在晚上11点前难以入睡。

ex.s: I'd fallen asleep, when I heard Dad's phone ringing.
ex.t: 我刚睡着，就听到爸爸的电话响了。

ex.s: Morrie says that most people “seem half-asleep”, even when they’re doing things they think are important.
ex.t: 莫里说，大多数人即使在做自认为重要的事情时，也“似乎半睡半醒”。

ex.s: But the city’s one million people were asleep as usual that night.
ex.t: 但那天夜里，这座城市的一百万居民像往常一样睡着了。

ex.s: I must have been asleep in that part of our history class!
ex.t: 我们历史课讲那部分时，我一定睡着了！

ex.s: Very , I slid into bed and fell fast asleep that night.
ex.t: 我悄悄钻进被窝，那天晚上很快就沉沉地睡着了。
